Deduplication is often one step within entity resolution. Deduplication generally identifies duplicate records within a dataset, whereas entity resolution can connect related records across multiple sources and determine which records collectively represent the same real-world entity.
What Is an Entity Resolution Framework?

An entity resolution framework is the end-to-end process used to identify which records refer to the same real-world entity. It defines how data is prepared, how potential matches are generated and evaluated, how related records are grouped, and how uncertain decisions are reviewed and monitored.

Modern platforms rank sources per attribute using observed freshness and completeness rather than trusting a fixed hierarchy, and retain provenance so every surviving value can be traced back to its source.
